title: strobe.json
description: A project's strobe configuration (SPEC 9.5). JSON with // and /* */ comments and trailing commas. strobe refuses a key it does not read or a value of the wrong type (exit 2, with the file, line and column).

build.description: What a directory or git variant runs before it is measured. build.windows, build.macos and build.linux overlay the rest on that OS (env merged key by key, other keys replaced).

serve.description: How a web() target serves a variant's build; {port} is a free port per variant.

cwd.description: Where the server runs, from the variant's checkout root (not the folder of strobe.json).

ready.description: A URL that answers once the server is up.

dir.description: The folder the origin serves, for source maps (else build.output), from the variant's checkout root.

apps.description: App profiles by id: app:<id> targets and native(<id>) bench targets (SPEC 13.2, 13.7).

benches.description: Reserved: globs of the project's bench files, for tools. strobe does not read it yet.

equivalence.description: The equivalence bound for same, in percent: "2%" or "2".

harness.description: Repository-relative paths copied into every variant before it builds (SPEC 9.5).

prune.description: This machine's setting, read only from your own <state>/strobe.json (a project's file may not set it) (SPEC 5.14).

unused.description: Caches unused this long go on their own, once a day: an age ("14d", the default) or "off".

unit.description: The unit times print in: us (microseconds, the default), ms or s; --unit overrides it. Stored and --json numbers keep their metric's unit.

perOs.description: One path, or one per OS.

command.description: {cache} is a folder shared by every worktree of the repository.

cwd.description: Where the build runs, from the variant's checkout root (a git ref's worktree, or the checkout a folder variant is in), not the folder of strobe.json.

output.description: What the build writes, from the variant's checkout root.

exe.description: ~, %VAR% and ${VAR} expand from the user's environment.

extends.description: A parent profile; objects merge per key.

kind.description: electron (default): a debugging port. webview: the app embeds the OS's webview (WebView2 on Windows). native: from outside and through the accessibility tree.

env.description: {home} is the copy's private home, {port} a free port.

files.description: Files written into the home: JSON or text; a string that is exactly {port} becomes a number.

guard.description: The user's own state, which must not change while a copy runs.

pid.description: The key in the file's JSON naming a process that must stay alive.

url.description: The key in the file's JSON naming a URL that must keep answering.

window.description: false: the app opens no window (a tray app).

moved.description: The user's folders the profile's env moves into the home (macOS).

display.description: Linux, kind native: "wayland" runs the app on a headless Wayland compositor strobe starts per launch (frames and input latency refused Headless); "x11" on the session's X server. Default: Wayland when DISPLAY is unset.

motion.description: What makes the app prefer reduced motion, as its owner declares it: a target with motion: "reduce" adds it to its launch. Required for a native target with motion (else NotForTarget); an Electron or webview app also gets Chromium's switch. strobe never changes the OS's own setting.

args.description: Arguments after the profile's and the target's; {home} and {port} are filled in.

env.description: Environment after the profile's and the target's.

files.description: Files in the home, merged over what the seed and the profile wrote: a JSON object key by key at every depth; text replaces.
